name: io.github.abeljumanuel/axiom-meridian
title: Axiom Meridian
description: Serves only the team rules and lessons learned relevant to a project. Code drifts. Meridian doesn't.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_BASE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Knowledge base root (Markdown files + SQLite index). Defaults to an OS-specific per-user data directory.

environmentVariables.name: MERIDIAN_ACCESS_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Which tools may run: read, analyze, or write (write is needed to approve proposals).
